item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Anna Maria Island businesses brace for proposed paid parking plan
item.description: A controversial proposal to bring paid parking to Anna Maria Island is stirring concern among local business owners who say charging beachgoers to park could cost them customers.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: city council] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa Bay Rays eye September groundbreaking for 2.3 billion ballpark
item.description: Last week, Tampa City Council and Hillsborough County approved a combined $876 million in public funds for the project. The team’s ownership group has pledged to cover the remaining $1.37 billion, along with any construction cost overruns.
